insights.one_liner: Motel One is a Munich-based budget design hotel chain with over 90 hotels in 12 countries; a recognised visa sponsor with an entry-level Rotterdam role needing no Dutch.

culture.text: About 1,575 people on LinkedIn, mostly in hotel operations and customer service, often with hospitality or tourism degrees from German schools.
It says it gives employees a stake in the company's success through incentives and aims to keep staff satisfaction high.
Its one open job here is an entry-level role in Rotterdam.

open.text: Motel One Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in Munich in 2000, it now runs more than 90 hotels in 12 countries.
